source_title: Liquid Viscosity and Surface Tension of n-Hexane, n-Octane, n-Decane, and n-Hexadecane up to 573 K by Surface Light Scattering (SLS)
extraction: All eleven n-hexane rows manually transcribed and visually checked against PDF page 11; no interpolation.
density_role: Literature input to the SLS evaluation; not an independent measured density in this experiment.
pressure_note: Initial helium partial pressure approximately 0.1 MPa; authors treat measurements as saturation conditions because helium effect is negligible. These rows are not constant-total-pressure 0.1 MPa data.
uncertainty_note: Row-specific relative expanded viscosity uncertainties; do not replace with the paper-wide mean or assume independent systematic uncertainty across temperatures.
